mapper.select: SELECT id, name, sort_name AS sortName, comment, cover_path AS coverPath, owner, owner_id AS ownerId, is_public AS isPublic, song_count AS songCount, duration, total_size AS totalSize, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM playlist WHERE owner = #{owner} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id, name, sort_name AS sortName, comment, cover_path AS coverPath, owner, owner_id AS ownerId, is_public AS isPublic, song_count AS songCount, duration, total_size AS totalSize, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM playlist WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, sort_name AS sortName, comment, cover_path AS coverPath, owner, owner_id AS ownerId, is_public AS isPublic, song_count AS songCount, duration, total_size AS totalSize, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM playlist WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist (name, sort_name, comment, cover_path, owner, owner_id, is_public, song_count, duration, total_size, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{sortName}, #{comment}, #{coverPath}, #{owner}, #{ownerId}, #{isPublic}, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE playlist SET name = #{name}, sort_name = #{sortName}, comment = #{comment}, cover_path = #{coverPath}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE playlist SET song_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_track WHERE playlist_id = #{id}), duration = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.duration) FROM playlist_track pt JOIN song s ON pt.song_id = s.id WHERE pt.playlist_id = #{id}), 0), total_size = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.file_size) FROM playlist_track pt JOIN song s ON pt.song_id = s.id WHERE pt.playlist_id = #{id}), 0), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE playlist p SET song_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_track pt WHERE pt.playlist_id = p.id), duration = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.duration) FROM playlist_track pt JOIN song s ON pt.song_id = s.id WHERE pt.playlist_id = p.id), 0), total_size = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.file_size) FROM playlist_track pt JOIN song s ON pt.song_id = s.id WHERE pt.playlist_id = p.id), 0), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE p.id = #{id}
